title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
layout_note: Two bottom-up towers (query on the left, keys on the right) that bend toward each other into one 'similarity' then 'contrastive loss' apex.
grouping: No frames or panels; the two towers are separated by whitespace. A curly brace groups the key samples under the right tower. The two encoders form a colour pair: pale green for the encoder, pale blue for the momentum encoder.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with pale fills and no outline or shadow; thin grey arrows with small heads; elbowed arrows from q and the key row turn inward to 'similarity'. Variables are typeset math (x^query, x_0^key, q, k_0 k_1 k_2 ...). The queue is the row of key symbols labelled 'queue'.
proposed_highlight: The momentum encoder is the only blue box against the green encoder, and the dictionary is named 'queue' beside the k_0 k_1 k_2 ... row.
lesson: Draw a two-encoder contrastive method as two bottom-up towers whose top arrows elbow inward to a single similarity-then-loss apex, and mark the novel encoder only by a different pale fill.
notes: Venue/year: arXiv 2019 (year = arXiv preprint year); remembered venue CVPR 2020, not printed on the arXiv PDF. Single-column figure. Fig. 2 of the paper is a three-panel side-by-side comparison (end-to-end / memory bank / MoCo) worth a separate card.

insights.structure: Two unframed towers stand side by side, query on the left and keys on the right, and meet at a shared apex of 'similarity' and 'contrastive loss' text at the top centre.
insights.data: Inputs and outputs are typeset symbols only: x^query and a brace over x_0^key, x_1^key, ... at the bottom, and q and a k_0 k_1 k_2 ... row labelled 'queue' above the encoders.
insights.emphasis: The momentum encoder is set apart only by its pale blue fill against the pale green encoder; nothing else is coloured.
insights.flow: Both towers read bottom-to-top along thin grey arrows, and the last arrows elbow inward to the similarity label between the towers.
insights.avoid: The momentum update that ties the two encoders, the method's core, is not drawn (no arrow between the boxes), and the queue is just a text label on a row of symbols.

arrangement.units: two vertical unframed columns separated by whitespace: query tower (left) and key tower (right)
arrangement.inputs_as: typeset math symbols; the key samples grouped by a curly brace
arrangement.losses_at: once, at the top centre where the two towers meet ('similarity' then 'contrastive loss')
arrangement.shared: none: encoder and momentum encoder are separate boxes with no drawn link

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
